text: {"rules":[{"id":"GDM-SCREEN-PREG-24WK","version":"August 2021","title":"Gestational diabetes screening in asymptomatic pregnant persons at 24 weeks of gestation or after","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends screening for gestational diabetes in asymptomatic pregnant persons at 24 weeks of gestation or after.","grade":"B","effective_date":"August 2021","action":"Screen for gestational diabetes","denominator":"{\"all\": [{\"condition\": {\"concept\": \"pregnancy\"}, \"quote\": \"pregnant persons\"}, {\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"gestational age (at or after 24 weeks of gestation)\"}, \"quote\": \"at 24 weeks of gestation or after\"}, {\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"clinician assessment that the patient is asymptomatic for diabetes\"}, \"quote\": \"asymptomatic\"}], \"quote\": \"asymptomatic pregnant persons at 24 weeks of gestation or after\"}","numerator":"{\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"glucose_test\", \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"screening for gestational diabetes\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"text ties screening to the current pregnancy at >=24 weeks, not a calendar interval; measurement year used as a proxy for the pregnancy period\"}, \"note\": \"Screening should occur during the current pregnancy at or after 24 weeks of gestation; engine cannot verify timing relative to gestational age.\"}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["Gestational age (24 weeks or after) has no vocabulary concept and is encoded as uncomputable; a clinic with structured gestational-age data could add a new concept (e.g. gestational_age_weeks).","'Asymptomatic' requires clinical assessment and is encoded as uncomputable.","Numerator uses glucose_test (plasma glucose or HbA1c screening) as the closest concept; GDM screening is typically a glucose challenge test or OGTT, which may warrant a dedicated concept (e.g. gdm_screening_test). The text does not specify the test method.","Numerator window (measurement year) is a derived proxy for 'during the current pregnancy at or after 24 weeks'; flagged for human review.","Text does not state exclusion of pre-existing diabetes; no exclusions were added.","DATE field contains an asterisk footnote marker ('August 2021 *') whose meaning is not provided in the section text."]}
